title: Sakura Taisen: Teigeki Graph: Teigeki Graph in Sakura Wars
native_title: サクラ大戦 ～帝撃グラフ～
overview: Sakura Taisen: Teigeki Graph is a multimedia fan disc for the Sakura Wars series, containing an original side-story and a collection of five mini-games such as a piano rhythm game and a jigsaw puzzle. Also included are a Sakura Taisen encyclopedia, illustration and video galleries, and a selection of cast interviews.
